title: Capture of Carolusborg (1658)
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Capture of Carolusborg (1658)", at revision 1370608441, opens: "The capture of Carolusborg (1658) was carried out by the newly recruited Hendrik Carloff who seized the Swedish fort of Carolusborg on the Gold Coast." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q125768358, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "colonial conflict between the Danes and Swedes". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
